vectors.name: single_frame_none
vectors.description: One uncompressed frame containing a provider JSON payload.
vectors.expected_behavior: Reader returns one payload byte-identical to payload_hex and reports CLEAN when footer is present.

vectors.name: missing_footer_recoverable
vectors.description: A valid complete frame without a footer.
vectors.expected_behavior: Reader returns the complete frame and reports UNCLEAN_RECOVERABLE.

vectors.name: unsupported_compression
vectors.expected_behavior: Reader reports unsupported compression, not file corruption.
